title.en: Choose activities for vitality, not performance.
title.zh: 为生命力选择活动，而不只是为表现。

subtitle.en: Practice language for dance, swim, music, sports, and enrichment without turning every activity into a resume project.
subtitle.zh: 练习如何谈舞蹈、游泳、音乐、运动和兴趣班，而不把每个活动都变成履历项目。

audience: Parent of a young child · activity planning · Bay Area family life

note.en: Useful for centering movement, health, and lifelong habits.
note.zh: 适合把运动、健康和长期习惯放在中心。

note.en: Useful for framing music as expression, attention, and connection, not just achievement.
note.zh: 适合把音乐理解为表达、注意力和连接，而不只是成就。

moment.context: Other parents compare activities, lessons, swim levels, dance classes, piano progress, and sports schedules.
moment.avoid: We need to sign him up for more things so he does not fall behind.
moment.better: We are choosing activities that help him feel strong in his body, connected to other kids, and proud of effort. Dance, swim, music, and sports are not just achievements for us; they are ways to build vitality and confidence.

principle.en: Activities should expand the child, not consume the child.
principle.zh: 兴趣活动应该扩展孩子，而不是消耗孩子。

frames.en: For a young child, movement and play are not extras; they are part of development.
frames.zh: 对小孩来说，运动和游戏不是额外项目，而是发展的一部分。

frames.en: The right activity should build confidence, body awareness, joy, persistence, and connection.
frames.zh: 好的活动应该培养自信、身体觉察、快乐、坚持和连接。

frames.en: A child who is shy may benefit from structured activities with predictable routines and gentle social contact.
frames.zh: 害羞的孩子可能受益于有结构、有可预测流程、温和社交接触的活动。

frames.en: Do not turn every interest into early specialization.
frames.zh: 不要把每个兴趣都变成早期专项化。

phraseBank.line: We are using activities to help him feel capable, not to build a tiny resume.

why.en: It is warm, memorable, and gently anti-pressure.
why.zh: 温暖、好记，也温和地反压力。

phraseBank.line: He may need a little time to join, but he responds well to predictable routines and gentle encouragement.

why.en: It gives the adult a practical way to support the child.
why.zh: 给成人一个实际支持方法。

phraseBank.line: You do not have to be the best today. I love watching you try.

why.en: It shifts attention from performance to effort and connection.
why.zh: 把注意力从表现转到努力和连接。

meaning.en: A child's sense that their body can move, try, learn, and recover.
meaning.zh: 孩子觉得自己的身体能移动、尝试、学习和恢复的感受。

use.en: Swim and dance can build body confidence.
use.zh: 游泳和舞蹈可以建立 body confidence。

meaning.en: A practice that can support health and well-being for many years.
meaning.zh: 能长期支持健康和幸福感的习惯。

use.en: We care more about lifelong habits than early ranking.
use.zh: 我们更重视长期习惯，而不是早期排名。

meaning.en: Support that invites effort without pressure or shame.
meaning.zh: 邀请努力但不施压、不羞辱的支持。

use.en: He responds better to gentle encouragement than public correction.
use.zh: 相比公开纠正，他对 gentle encouragement 反应更好。

meaning.en: Focusing a young child intensely on one activity too early.
meaning.zh: 太早让小孩高强度专注单一项目。

use.en: We are avoiding early specialization and giving him room to explore.
use.zh: 我们避免 early specialization，给他探索空间。

scripts.line: I am looking for a class where he can move, enjoy the routine, and feel gently included.

why.en: It defines success in child-centered terms.
why.zh: 用儿童中心的方式定义成功。

scripts.line: Today was hard, and you stayed with it. That matters.

why.en: It recognizes persistence without pretending everything was easy.
why.zh: 承认坚持，不假装一切轻松。

scripts.line: We are trying to keep activities joyful enough that he wants to keep growing into them.

why.en: It explains why joy is not superficial; it protects long-term growth.
why.zh: 解释快乐不是肤浅，而是保护长期成长。

reflection.en: Activities are not only for skill acquisition; they are also for body, rhythm, courage, and belonging.
reflection.zh: 活动不只是获得技能，也关乎身体、节奏、勇气和归属感。

reflection.en: A shy child may not need fewer activities; he may need activities with better emotional entry.
reflection.zh: 害羞的孩子未必需要更少活动，他可能需要情绪入口更好的活动。

reflection.en: The parent voice here is playful, grounded, and protective of joy.
reflection.zh: 这里的父母声音是有游戏感、稳定、保护快乐的。
